violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children Adjusting Appropriately for Different Ages and Abilities (26 TAC §742.303(5))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children Adjusting Appropriately for Different Ages and Abilities
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregiver was not properly supervising a child, which resulted in the child climbing up stairs and then falling down the stairs.
